content.comment_body: Good morning. I need to display the current time of an On/Off Delay block in [product_name] Web Editor. On the display of [product_name], it is easy to select the block and add the 'current time' parameter. How can I do this in the web editor?

Hello, [user_name], welcome to the forum. This forum communicates in English, so please write future posts in English. To address your issue: you need to move the timer's parameter to VM memory via parameter-VM mapping. Then, in the web editor, select the analog value component, assign the VM parameter variable, mark it as writable, and choose the right time format.

Apologies for the language earlier. I'm not clear on how to 'move the timer's parameter to VM memory via parameter-VM mapping.' Could you provide an example or specify which block supports this functionality?

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to show the actual value of an On/Off Delay timer block in the web editor, similarly to how it's displayed on the hardware module. The main challenge is transferring the internal timer state from the automation controller to the web interface. There is confusion about the procedure and terminology, particularly around parameter-VM mapping, which shows the need for clearer instructions and guidance.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a straightforward and clear method to present the timer's current value in the web editor, matching the simplicity of the hardware display. They want defined, step-by-step instructions or a direct way to map this parameter easily.
